description: Find tracks inside the signed-in person's own collections by title, original title, creator, tag or the note on a collection item. Use it when someone asks whether or where they saved a track. Not for searching the whole catalog; use search_tracks for that. Returns results that name the collections holding each track, at most 50 per page, with cursor for the next page; capped is true when the match list hit its limit, so a narrower query finds more. Read-only; needs a signed-in account. Example: {"query":"rain loop"}.

cursor.description: The cursor from the previous page, to get the next one; left out for the first page.

query.description: Words to find, 2 to 100 characters, such as "rain loop". The last word also matches as a prefix.

name: search_collections
title: Find a track in your collections
